    • applyForInternship

      public void applyForInternship(Student student, InternshipFilter filter)
      Function for Student class Users. helps run the process of making an application, including displaying the applications the Student can apply for, Error checking to ensure that the Student is applying for a valid application Duplicate checking to ensure the Student has not applied for the internship before
      Parameters:
      student - the Student object that wants to make an application
      filter - the filter object that StudentController needs to use to display the appropriate internships

    • acceptInternshipOffer

      public void acceptInternshipOffer(Student student)
      function to handle the case where a student wants to accept/reject internship offers displays list of applications the Student can accept does error checking of inputs and also adjusts the Student attribute internship to correspond to the accepted internship if necessary
      Parameters:
      student - the Student object that wants to carry out the action

    • makeWithdrawal

      public void makeWithdrawal(Student student, List<WithdrawalRequest> withdrawalRequests)
      function to handle the case where a student wants to withdraw an application or internship displays list of applications or internships the Student can withdraw from does error checking of inputs and also adjusts the Student attribute applications to correspond to the withdrawal Adds the request to the withdrawalRequests array list for processing by CareerCentreStaff
      Parameters:
      student - the Student object that wants to carry out the action
      withdrawalRequests - the Arraylist containing withdrawal requests that the system uses
